This receptor is involved in the regulation of ion fluxes across cell membranes, and its activation can influence the activity of ATP-sensitive inward rectifier potassium channels. The proposed mechanism implies that methylphenidate may exert its effects on the ATP-sensitive inward rectifier potassium channel through a cascade involving the Alpha adrenergic receptor and Amorolfine.
